what_this_is: The Workshop row for the person's files in tools/live-namespace: tool:your-files, the session the engine keeps open and reaches by calls through its one door.

payload.label: Your files
payload.job: Every name of the person's files, listed, followed as it changes, read by range, written, moved, shared and released, for an AI or a device's folder, through the engine's one door
payload.description: The person's files (tools/live-namespace) as a session the engine keeps open and reaches only by calls: tools:run at @tools {tool: "tool:your-files", call: {name, arguments}} sends one MCP tools/call to the account's one session of this row, which the first call starts (trillion-rust src/tool_runs/tools/sessions.rs `call`); each call is answered on its own, so a list_changes that waits holds back no read. `name` is an operation of mcp-tools.json: list_files, list_changes, show_item, read_file_span, write_file, write_file_start, write_file_piece, write_file_finish, move_names, set_aside, put_back, make_folder, set_pin_rule, thumbnail, bounds, this_computer and the rest. The answer is {tool, result} with the operation's answer in result.structuredContent; a refusal is result.isError with {code, outcome}. read_file_span with raw: true answers the span's bytes themselves: {byte_slice: {total, offset, length, base64}}, or, to a request that accepts application/octet-stream, the raw bytes as the HTTP body with X-Total-Bytes and X-Offset (session.byte_result), so they cross the wire once. The run opens no port. Its names are rows in the person's own Postgres database (own-rows-postgres-connection, reached on the loopback port the computer reports as own-rows-postgres); its bytes are the person's own files-store connection, each field mounted on the descriptor settings.json `attached` names and never printed. The program is the live-namespace this computer keeps among its program folders.

output_schema.description: A call answers {tool, result: {structuredContent, content, isError}} or {tool, error}; the session's start answers its state.

provenance.source: Trillion-X/trillion-rust src/account_files at 5fbc2ff4b1 (moved into tools/live-namespace), over its own rows in SQL (src/store)
